page_title: ELC 1-0 VAL | Elche v Valencia 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Aleix Febas (Elche) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.

85' Hugo Duro (Valencia) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
84' The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
82' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Victor Chust (Elche) replaces German Valera.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) replaces Lucas Beltran.
78' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

77' What an opportunity! Leo Petrot (Elche) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
76' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Matias Dituro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
75' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Jose Gaya will be replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
75' Eray Comert goes off the pitch and Pepelu (Valencia) comes on.
75' The attendance for today's match is 27795.

73' 1 - 0 Goal! Aleix Febas plays in Lucas Cepeda (Elche), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:0.
72' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Gonzalo Villar and he is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
72' The substitution has been made. Lucas Cepeda (Elche) has replaced Martim Neto.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.

69' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Matias Dituro is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Valencia get a corner.
67' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick.
65' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
64' Here is a change. Buba Sangare is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to John Donald (Elche).
64' Substitution. Andre Silva walks off the pitch and Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) comes on as a substitute.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

62' Jose Gaya (Valencia) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball via the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the top of the net, but Matias Dituro makes a nice save. Now Valencia have a corner.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hugo Duro (Valencia) for Umar Sadiq.
60' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Luis Rioja is replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).

60' That didn't go as planned! Largie Ramazani (Valencia) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Matias Dituro, who easily kept it out.
59' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Buba Sangare (Elche) for his blatant foul.
59' Elche take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

58' Rafa Mir (Elche) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Stole Dimitrievski. Elche force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' Thierry Rendall (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
53' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Buba Sangare (Elche) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
51' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
49' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
44' Rafa Mir (Elche) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
44' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Elche.
41' Thierry Rendall (Valencia) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
38' Luis Rioja (Valencia) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Andre Silva (Elche) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
36' The ball rebounds to Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
35' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Leo Petrot (Elche) and blew his whistle. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
33' Jose Gaya (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for an infringement.
31' Elche keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
29' Rafa Mir (Elche) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
27' Jose Gaya (Valencia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

25' A sweet pass inside the box gives Rafa Mir (Elche) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
25' Andre Silva (Elche) picks up a long through ball, but Stole Dimitrievski deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
22' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

21' Tete Morente (Elche) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. Elche will have an opportunity.
19' Elche take a short corner kick.
19' German Valera (Elche) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Elche are going to take it.

16' Golden chance! Lucas Beltran (Valencia) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.

16' Eray Comert (Valencia) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
15' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
15' Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
13' PENALTY APPEAL after Buba Sangare (Elche) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
11' Elche enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' German Valera (Elche) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
9' Tete Morente (Elche) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Elche are taking a throw-in.
6' Thierry Rendall (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
4' Elche hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
1' Aleix Febas (Elche) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Valencia.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is the one to supervise the game today.
